CalibrationSettingView

class CalibrationSettingView(parent=None)[source]

Bases: QDialog, Ui_CalibrationSettingView, WindowConfig

Modal dialog with the calibration settings.

Each settings widget has the Qt property dataclass_property with the name of its CalibrationSetting field; get_data and set_data use it to read and fill the form. The logic is in CalibrationSettingController.

Parameters:
parentQDialog | None, optional

Parent widget. Default is None.

Attributes:
msgMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

controllerCalibrationSettingController

Controller of the dialog.

Notes

The window is fixed at 5% wider and 75% taller than the parent. The camera groups are enabled by the custom camera check box and the filter group by the filter check box.

Methods

closeEvent

Ask for confirmation before closing.

get_data

Read the settings from the widgets.

set_data

Fill the widgets with saved settings.
get_data()[source]

Read the settings from the widgets.

Returns:
dict[str, Any]

Values by dataclass_property name.

Notes

Check boxes give 1 or 0, spin boxes their value and combo boxes their current text. For radio buttons, only the checked one sets the value: its dataclass_property_value property, or its text.

set_data(data)[source]

Fill the widgets with saved settings.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any] | CalibrationSetting

Settings by field name, or a CalibrationSetting (read with get_data). Other types are ignored.

Notes

Empty or None values are skipped. Combo boxes select the item with the same text, and a radio button is checked when its dataclass_property_value (or text) equals the value.

closeEvent(event)[source]

Ask for confirmation before closing.

Parameters:
eventQCloseEvent

Close event; accepted only if the user confirms.
